title: Just built a game in 3 days - speechless
author: Adromakh
selftext:
I was searching for things to do with my subscription, created a folder named "Killed the Potato" and started Claude (opus 5.5). 

And here i am, 3 days later with a full 'mobile' auto-battle game. I'm speachless: i didnt write any line of code, i didnt create any asset (no music, no models). I was only driving claude with prompts to explain how i wanted the game to work, the mecanisms, the features, the art direction.

This game is not perfect, the art can obviously be improved, and the game type is very common. But it was the type of game i could buy for 1€ in the app store some years ago.

The game is here: [https://iga-prod.itch.io/kill-the-potatoes](https://iga-prod.itch.io/kill-the-potatoes)

Being able to do it myself is like a big wake up call. I'm really starting to question the future of this industry, especially the mobile game one. There will be game relying on existing IP that could still exist and be sold by 'big' studios. But there will be ton of new 'indie' games, the market will be completely flooded.

comments.author: adpowah
comments.body: You know there is already a fairly popular game where you wear armor and fight potatoes called Farmer Against Potato Incremental?

comments.author: Mental_Tailor_4227
comments.body: I really like the art work! What was your workflow on creating and animating?

replies.author: Adromakh
replies.body: None... I gave the general direction in the prompts and iterate until I have something good. The potatoes were ok almost immediately, the fighters needed more iterations.

replies.author: Mental_Tailor_4227
replies.body: Nice! I been trying to get something like that but stopped and just stuck to pixel code. Was this in codex ? Claude code ? I’ve tried to get something so detailed like this but failed :(

replies.author: Adromakh
replies.body: Claude code in a terminal. I gave him the link to the Godot executable, and started prompting the game. In the prompt I specifically asked him to use specialized agent for each part of the game, especially for the art. I remember I asked him to really do a focus on the art. Once the first version was here with the background, the potatoes etc, each time I ask to regenerate art I ask him to still respect the general da of the game.

replies.author: Mental_Tailor_4227
replies.body: Hmmm 🧐 I will have to practice my good sir thank you !
